title: Maximum fold over concatenation
statement: For any lists $a,b$ of natural numbers, folding the maximum with initial value $0$ over their concatenation gives the maximum of the two separate folds with initial value $0$.
replaced:
For lists of natural numbers $a$ and $b$, folding the maximum (with base $0$) over
the concatenation $a \mathbin{+\!\!+} b$ equals the maximum of the two separate
folds.
